concrete_evidence_delta.name: verified-vs-unverified derivation frontier on the real Lean hypergraph
design: Substrate: the mechanical parse of formal/RaklFormal.lean from tests/test_end_to_end_real_problem.py (87 theorem nodes, dependency hyperedges, kernel-grade certificates).
Targets: every theorem with at least one dependency (sweep, not just the single test target).
Worlds: clean (no corruption) and planted (k in 1..K certificates corrupted to unresolvable subjects, seeded, multiple draws per k).
Arm A (unverified): derivation over the same hyperedges with certificate checking disabled (licensed_at asserted, the pre-certificates behavior the module documents as the dead-gate shape).
Arm B (verified): certified_hyperedge + verify_derivation as shipped.

MEASURED endpoints: clean-world wall-time and edges-fired overhead of B vs A; A's false-derivation acceptance rate under corruption; B's localization precision (blocked edge set == planted set) and clean-world non-suppression (B must still derive every clean target - the null-equivalent-refusal guard from the benefit_L* protocols).
CONFORMANCE endpoints (declared, not evidence): B blocks on planted corruption (true by construction).
Chronology: protocol + evaluator frozen and committed before any sweep result is observed; RSHEA binding as in research/benefit_L0_fcr_v1/README.md if run as a benefit arm.
concrete_evidence_delta.runnability: HONEST ASSESSMENT: CPU-only and small - pure Python + regex parse, 87 nodes; a full sweep (all targets x k x seeds) is minutes on laptop billy. Statistical power is bounded by the single small graph: report per-world exact counts, no asymptotic claims. NOT executed in this audit: Paper V execution belongs to the paper56-frontier lane; this audit contributes the framing, the endpoint classification and the runnability verdict.
concrete_evidence_delta.what_it_does_not_test: No LLM anywhere in the loop; nothing about generator quality, proof search, autoformalization or discovery performance. It prices the verification layer; it does not vindicate it.

must_not_be_claimed: No discovery-performance claim (PV-Q3 remains prospective and resource-blocked).
'Verified arm catches planted corruption' is conformance by construction - never reportable as a measured benefit (dead-gate precedent).
Planted-corruption worlds are known-answer instrument worlds, not external benchmarks; scope matches benefit_L0-L2, not natural mathematical practice.
No live-path assurance claim while the premise (iii) call chain terminates in tests.
The 2343-test / implementation-SHA figures in the manuscript are repository facts, not evidence for any benefit.
